question: Can the two SOXX original 2019 transition schedules yield disclosed common-equity concentration with exact printed value closure, without outcomes or model fitting?
formula: Within each pinned SOXX Schedule, parse Common Stocks Security/Shares/Value rows up to Total Common Stocks; require 20-40 distinct security names, positive original shares and USD values, zero ambiguous numeric security rows, printed Total Common Stocks and sum difference <=1 USD. Normalize each stock's original USD fair value by the sum of the parsed common-equity values; top5 is the sum of the five largest normalized weights, HHI is the sum of squared normalized weights. Preserve printed names and values; no ticker matching or official index-weight inference.
availability: A report-period date is not decision availability. Preserve SEC filing date and accepted-display time separately; any Stage1 Qlib map must use the next actual session strictly after the filing date and must keep unknown periods unknown.
stop: Any row ambiguity, count failure, missing printed total or value nonclosure stops source qualification without adjusting rows or switching filings. Preserve failure evidence and freeze a narrow mechanical repair before another pass.
